description: Dependency updates that respect the supply-chain policy (docs/dependency-policy.md): nothing is proposed before it has been public for 3 days (pnpm itself refuses anything younger than 1 day), versions are pinned exactly, and every pull request must pass the full CI.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix still waits out a minimum release age (1 day, the same as pnpm): the policy has no bypass.

packageRules.description: TypeScript stays on 6.0.x until dependency-cruiser supports 7 (CLAUDE.md, Conventions).
PostgreSQL 17 everywhere (ADR 0014): the code refuses any other major.
Node 24 LTS (.nvmrc, engines): a new LTS is a deliberate upgrade, not a bot pull request.
These families move together: one pull request each.
Majors are never automatic: they are read, planned and done by hand.
GitHub Actions are updated together, as pull requests like everything else.
